title: KCIDB ingestion
description: Submissions to KCIDB (db.kernelci.org) by origin, volume, errors and the ingestion backlog

list.name: rate
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Scraped every 5m; keep this at 15m or more

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: All errors; system and user errors are counted separately below

panels.title: Spool backlog
panels.description: JSON files waiting in the spool directory. Growing means ingestion is falling behind

panels.title: Ingester
panels.description: kcidb-ng-ingester on db.kernelci.org:2003, which moves spooled submissions into the database

panels.title: Ingestion queue
panels.description: Files the ingester has picked up but not yet written to the database

panels.title: Submissions by origin
panels.description: Log scale: broonie submits orders of magnitude more than everyone else

panels.title: Origins
panels.description: Last submission is how long ago the origin's counter last moved (15 minute resolution, 30 days back). An origin going quiet usually means a broken lab or expired token

panels.title: Received vs ingested
panels.description: The two lines should track each other. Ingested falling below received means the spool is growing

panels.title: Labs (selected time range)
panels.description: lab is where the work ran (e.g. lava-collabora); origin is who submitted it (e.g. maestro)

panels.title: Top 20 platforms by tests
panels.description: Platform 'None' (submissions without a platform, mostly broonie) is left out
